chapter_theme: Songs at Vellore (வேலூர்), a rich town of mango, honey and sugar presses: the poet confesses bondage to courtesans who welcome givers and drive off the rest, and to women who destroy young men, and asks for the feet and a truthful worship; the praise tells Sambandar's victory over the Jains at Madurai as Murugan's own.

666.reading: The poet lists the courtesans who show delight when men who give much wealth come and drive away those who do not give even after union, illusions who feign friendship and make men fools, show their breasts and their beauty to anyone as if in love, wandering prostitutes without compassion, and asks on what day he will leave their ways and join Murugan's feet. The praise tells how, in the Pandya land of Madurai, Murugan smeared holy ash on the king who leaned to the Jains, straightened his hump, sent the palm leaf up against the river's current, and, praised by the queen, destroyed the Jains to the root; and names Vellore, where mangoes fall, honey flows and sugar presses run day and night.
666.nuance: அதிகராய்ப் பொருள் ஈவார் நேர்படில் ரசனை காட்டிகள், ஈயார் கூடினும் அகல ஓட்டிகள்: love measured to the gift. The praise tells the Madurai episode of Sambandar in full (the ash, the hump, the leaf against the stream, the queen, அழகி), all as Murugan's deed. Two words have corrupt glyphs.

667.reading: The poet tells of women whose eyes defeat the fish and the spear, who set out first to ruin young men's prosperity and minds, come with honeyed words and embrace them, and bring a sorrowful pleasure that never ends, and asks that, infatuated by their show, his love not wane and his limbs not waste, but that he be given grace to worship daily with keen truthfulness, having overcome countless evils. The praise names Murugan who rode the peacock and defeated the great Sura, who threw the vel at the hill while the gods stood in pity, and Vellore, where women with bamboo-like shoulders come to worship.
667.nuance: தீராத துன்ப இன்பம்: the pleasure the women give is itself a sorrow. கூர்வாய்மை கொண்டு இறைஞ்ச: worship asked for is worship with truthfulness. கோள்கோடி பொன்ற வென்று may mean overcoming the planets, or slanders; the opening lines of the praise on Kama's cane bow are hard to divide.

links.note: Both make the courtesan's welcome depend on the gift: the Naladiyar's women send away even Mal if his hand is empty, and 666's women show delight to the man who gives much and drive off one who does not.
653 gives Sambandar's defeat of the Jains as one epithet of Murugan; 666 tells the whole Madurai episode, the ash on the king, the hump straightened, the leaf against the current, as Murugan's deed.

source_issues: Song 666: two corrupt characters, in தேனு஡றல்கள் (line 581, probably தேனூறல்கள்) and வேலு஡ர் (line 586, probably வேலூர்).
Song 667: one corrupt character in வேலு஡ர் (line 605, probably வேலூர்).
